title: AuditEvent
description: The de_audit external-audit INTERFACE contract — the request a caller sends and the response an engine returns. This repo ships the INTERFACE SHAPE ONLY (what to call, what comes back) plus a non-implementing stub; it deliberately does NOT ship the engine. Vendor selection / per-mode routing, panel-convergence weighting, and any ground_truth are engine-internal (the external cloud decision-engine) and are intentionally ABSENT from this contract — convergence adjudication (weighing agreeing vs diverging voices) is the CALLER's job, not a field here. See contracts/audit/README.md. Contract changes require mutual agreement with the engine side (bump schema_version, sync both).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Only 1.0 exists; an engine routes an unsupported version to an error rather than guessing.

event_type.description: Discriminator. Constrains the payload shape via the allOf branches below.

payload.description: Shape depends on event_type — constrained by the allOf branches below.

allOf.comment: AuditRequest — what a caller (human / agent / any client) sends to de_audit.

artifact.description: The MATERIAL UNDER REVIEW ONLY — raw code / doc / plan. NEVER fold review instructions, framing, or pre-mortem prompts into it; those go in context/focus. (Folding framing in causes a reviewer to flag your own review scaffolding as a finding.)

context.description: Intent + acceptance criteria for the material. Free text; advisory to the engine.

focus.description: A specific dimension / question to steer the review (e.g. one aqg-multi-review dimension prompt).

mode.description: Public review-depth ladder (see docs/AUDIT_DECISION_MODEL.md). WHICH auditor voices a mode maps to is ENGINE-INTERNAL and is NOT part of this contract.

stakes.description: Caller's risk signal; advisory. An engine MAY auto-upgrade depth on high stakes.

caller_family.description: Opaque caller model-family label; advisory, lets the engine avoid same-family voices for independence. No vendor value is presupposed.

allOf.comment: AuditResponse — what the engine returns. Carries the verdict SHAPE only; the panel labels are opaque and no convergence score is included (adjudication is the caller's).

audit_id.description: Opaque engine-assigned id. NOT a content hash; format is engine-internal.

mode_effective.description: The depth actually run (MAY differ from requested after an auto-upgrade).

panel.description: OPAQUE voice labels. Vendor identities, per-mode routing, and voice weighting are engine-internal moat and are NOT part of this contract — treat each entry as a display label only.

verdicts.description: One entry per voice. The per-voice verdict SHAPE; the contract does NOT rank or converge them (the caller adjudicates).

voice_label.description: Opaque display label for this voice.

note.description: Optional engine free-text (e.g. degraded / dropped-voice notice).
